newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Drugs maker to join Bucharest bourse trading.
newsitem.headline: Drugs maker to join Bucharest bourse trading.

text.p: Private pharmaceutical company Terapia SA will join second-tier trading on the Bucharest bourse on March 27, bringing to 28 the number of traded stocks on both tiers, the exchange said on Tuesday.

Terapia has a capital of 41.32 billion lei in shares with a nominal value of 1,000 lei each. It was privatised under a mass selloff launched in 1995, with 48.7 percent of its equity subscribed for in exchange for coupons.
Employees of Terapia hold about 27 percent of the capital, the private company Romferchim SA has a 23.9 percent stake.
On Monday, the bourse said state-run Grimex SA mining equipment maker would join the second tier on April 2.
The Bucharest bourse has only two first-tier listings -- Azomures SA fertiliser maker, and Oltchim SA chemical plant. The two have dominated trading over the past months.
